import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # standardise species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    species_map = {'gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'adelie': 'Adelie'}
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace(species_map)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.title()
    # standardise island label variants / typos
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    island_map = {'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'}
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace(island_map)
    # numeric columns may be stored as text
    num_cols = ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']
    for col in num_cols:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # fix negative flipper lengths
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    return df

def answer(df):
    dfc = clean(df)
    # keep only allowed species
    allowed = {'Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo'}
    dfc = dfc[dfc['species'].isin(allowed)]
    totals = dfc.groupby('species', dropna=True)['body_mass_g'].sum()
    # return plain dict with numeric totals
    result = {}
    for k, v in totals.items():
        if pd.isna(v):
            continue
        # keep int when possible
        if float(v).is_integer():
            result[k] = int(v)
        else:
            result[k] = float(v)
    return result
